slides.head: of buyer inquiries never got a reply from an agent
slides.body: In one US study. Here's where yours could be leaking.
slides.scene: a cosy little real-estate agency office with a pretty model house on the desk, a laptop and a desk phone surrounded by a cloud of floating blank message bubbles that nobody is reading, an empty office chair

slides.head: The inquiry nobody answers
slides.body: In one US study, **48%** of home-buyer inquiries never got a reply from an agent. They asked. No agent answered. Awkward.
slides.source: WAV Group for Weichert, 2013–14, 384 inquiries, 11 US states; auto-replies not counted
slides.scene: a hopeful home buyer waiting at the front door of a charming small house, holding a phone with a blank message bubble, nobody answering, a tiny cobweb on the doorbell

slides.head: The hour that slips away
slides.body: Reply within an hour and you're **~7×** likelier to qualify the lead than if you wait even an hour longer. The lead doesn't wait. The clock definitely doesn't.
slides.source: HBR 2011, 1.25M web leads at 42 US companies (all industries)
slides.scene: a giant hourglass with the sand almost run out standing outside a small real-estate office, while a home buyer walks away down the street

slides.head: “We’ll get back to you”
slides.body: In a test of US companies, **23%** never replied to a web lead at all. Not late. Never.
slides.source: HBR 2011, audit of 2,241 US firms (all industries)
slides.scene: an office in-tray piled high with unopened envelopes covered in dust and cobwebs on a desk in an empty office, a wilted plant beside it

slides.head: The contact form that writes to a ghost
slides.body: Where does your website form actually go? An old inbox? An ex-employee? Send yourself an inquiry tonight and time the reply.
slides.scene: a friendly little cartoon ghost sitting at a desk in a dusty abandoned office, paper letters flying in through a mail slot and piling up unread around it

slides.head: The 11 pm message
slides.body: A buyer messages after hours. What answers them before morning? If the answer is “nothing”, that's the leak.
slides.scene: night scene under a moon and stars: a home buyer on a sofa in a cosy lit house typing on a glowing phone, next door a small real-estate office completely dark with the lights off

slides.body: An instant first reply on WhatsApp or email, straight into your CRM, with an automatic follow-up. Your agents still close; no inquiry waits for a first reply.
